role: Extension of ReanalysisService: sleep retro-apply over all overnight sessions (nap credit included, applied on the archived copy under the archive lock), manual-window reanalysis/apply, sleep-boundary updates (user edits and automatic HealthKit refreshes), run one after another off the main actor through SleepBoundaryWrite with re-classification and re-scoring on the archived copy, training-snapshot repair, and segment unlinking; and ArchivedSessionRead, which tells a session the archive does not hold apart from one whose read throws.
types: ReanalysisService.TrainingRepairResult: struct — counts and sample log of a training-snapshot repair
ArchivedSessionRead: enum (file scope, Sendable) — stored / notArchived / unreadable result of one archive read; read(_:from:caller:) logs a thrown read at .error
toplevel: Only the three private static constants and TrainingRepairResult (sampleLog defaults '').

units.does: Filters sessions to overnight ones with RR data, re-runs the sleep pipeline for each (stopping on cancellation) counting rewritten sessions, reports progress, notifies archive changed, logs and returns the count.

units.does: For one session: end = endDate or start+12 h; fetches fresh sleep (with nap credit), checks shouldRetroApply on the sweep's copy, then hands off to persistRetroApply, which applies, re-classifies, re-scores and writes on the archived copy; returns whether it was written.

Fetches HealthKit sleep for the session (validated against its RR points) and credits the day-before's qualifying nap (fetchDaytimeNapMinutes + withNapSleepMinutes), as the morning path does; nil on error (logged).

Recording length in ms for clamping: last beat's endMs, or (end-start) seconds*1000 when no beats.

units.entry: Closure body of SessionArchive.update in persistRetroApply (runs under the archive lock).

units.does: Starts from the current archived copy of the session (latestArchivedCopy, falling back to the given copy), hydrates it from the archive if lightweight, picks frozen training context (snapshot → result → provider), and asks the pipeline to reanalyze at targetMs with the session's ANS config.

units.does: Starts a sleep-boundary update and returns its task at once; the task's value is true only when the update was persisted. The task first waits for the previous edit (pendingSleepEdit), so edits land in the order they were made, then runs runSleepBoundaryUpdate; it becomes pendingSleepEdit for the next edit. Returns false (as the task's value) on missing start or end, a session not in the archive, an automatic update that does not apply, inputs that kept changing, or an error.

branches.effect: runs at once; else waits for it

units.does: One sleep edit: builds the Edit (false, logged, when sleepStart or sleepEnd is nil); reads the session on a detached task (false, logged, when not archived); writes it (writeUntilCurrent: re-score inputs captured on the main actor, SleepBoundaryWrite.write on a detached task, run again from the stored copy while the inputs changed, up to RescoreWrite.runs times); when written, reportSleepUpdate and true; false when declined, no longer archived or the inputs kept changing. A thrown read or write is logged at .error and returns false.

Returns the session as written with the night minutes of the copy it was written from; nil when declined or no longer archived, or (logged) when the inputs kept changing. Rethrows a write error.

Returns false with nothing written (link kept) when the parent or link is missing, when the segment can't be read so its beats can't be located, or when retrieve/archive throws (logged at .error).

False (logged at error level) only when the segment can't be read; a parent with no beats or a segment with no span has nothing to strip and returns true.
Segment length in ms from its duration, else the last beat's t_ms, else 0.
